76aca7380e.substituent_description: An indole-type bicycle (five-membered ring with N and one drawn C=C, fused to a circled benzene) carries Ac on the pyrrole carbon next to the ring-fusion carbon; the ring N carries CH2-C(=O)-N(iPr)-CH2-C(=O)-NH-CH2-aryl, where the aryl is a circled benzene attached at C1 with F at C2 (ortho) and Cl at C3 (meta, next to F). On the benzo ring, the carbon next to the N-bearing fusion carbon (indole C7) carries CH2-C(=O)-N of a piperidine that has two F on the carbon next to the ring N (3,3-difluoro); a bond stub at the right image edge (indole C5) may carry a cut-off substituent.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The right edge of the image cuts through the indole benzo ring: a dark bond stub at the ring vertex on the edge (indole C5) suggests a substituent that is cropped off and cannot be read
iPr label: the r is smudged against a dot
76aca7380e.notes: Handwritten black ink on grey paper, photographed at an angle. Dark blobs at some bond ends (e.g. at N to ring carbon) are pen pressure, not wedges. Both benzene rings are circles; the five-membered ring has one inner double line (C2=C3). Three C=O double bonds (two amides plus the ketone-type C=O to the piperidine N).

0437307d9d.substituent_description: Pyrrolidine N is bonded to C(=O)-NH-CH2-CH2-N of a piperazine; the other piperazine N is bonded directly to a circled benzene, which carries O-CH2 at the meta position (1,3-relationship to the piperazine N). The CH2 is joined by a hashed bond to a carbon of a 1,3-dioxolane (C, O, C, O, C); the ketal carbon of the dioxolane bears a 2,4-dichlorophenyl (Cl ortho and para to the attachment) and a hashed bond to CH2 that is bonded to N of an imidazole-type ring (N-C-N pattern, two C=C/C=N double bonds drawn).
0437307d9d.notes: Handwritten black ink. NH is written as N with H beneath it. The five-membered N-heterocycle at the bottom right is drawn with alternating double bonds (C=N on left side, C=C on right side); both benzene rings are circles. Two hashed bonds, no solid wedges.

968ab97411.substituent_description: A fused 6-5 bicycle: the circled six-membered ring has two adjacent ring N atoms at the top; the ring carbon next to one N carries NH2 and the ring carbon next to the other N carries COO-C(CH3)3 (tert-butyl ester written out with C and three CH3). The fused five-membered ring has two N atoms (one N=C double bond drawn); its N next to the fusion carbon that is adjacent to the COO carbon is attached by a solid wedge to a cyclohexane. On the cyclohexane (C1 = wedge carbon), the adjacent C2 carries BocNH on a hashed bond and C4 (para to C1) carries a hashed bond to a CH2 that bears CO2H.
968ab97411.notes: Handwritten black ink on white paper. NH2 is drawn vertically as H over N over H. Ring with N-N is drawn with a circle; the five-membered ring has a single inner double line. The hashed bond on the lower right ends at a plain-bond vertex before CO2H.

62d62d3a8a.substituent_description: (iPr)(NHBoc)CH-C(=O)-NH-CH(CH2CH2CH2-NH-C(=O)-NH2)-C(=O)-NH-aryl, with a solid wedge to iPr on the first stereocentre and a solid wedge to the CH2 chain on the second. The aryl benzene has HN (amide) at C1, CH2-N(Me)-C(=O)-O-CH2-(9-fluorenyl) at C3 (meta to the HN) and CH2OH at C4 (para to the HN, ortho to the CH2N group).
62d62d3a8a.notes: Typeset reference-style drawing. 13 double bonds = 4 C=O (urea, valine C=O, citrulline C=O, carbamate) + 3 in the central benzene + 3 in each of the two fluorene benzene rings. The fluorene central ring is five-membered with no double bonds. The label under the citrulline alpha-N is N with H beneath it.

333791d901.substituent_description: A 3,4-difluorophenyl (circled benzene; NH at C1, F at C3 and F at C4, i.e. meta and para) is bonded through NH to C(=O)-CH, where the CH has a hashed bond to an unlabelled terminal carbon and an O-C(=O)-CH2-CH2-N chain. The terminal N is the ring N of a six-membered N,O lactam ring fused to a circled benzene: N is bonded to one benzo carbon, the ring O is bonded to the ortho benzo carbon, and the ring is closed through CH2 and C(=O) (benzoxazinone-type).
333791d901.notes: Handwritten black ink on white paper. NH is written with H above N. Three C=O double bonds (amide, ester, lactam). The single hashed bond ends at an unlabelled vertex near the top of the drawing (implicit methyl). Both benzene rings are circles.

fa07a7f70b.substituent_description: A para-disubstituted circled benzene: OPh on one ring carbon and, on the opposite (para) carbon, a CH2 that leads to a CH carrying NHBoc (on a plain bond going up) and MeOOC (on a hashed bond going left); i.e. Ar-CH2-CH(NHBoc)(MeOOC).
fa07a7f70b.notes: Handwritten black ink on white paper. The phenyl of OPh is written as the label Ph, not drawn as a ring. There is a dark smudge on a ring bond at the lower right of the benzene.

abab5cb525.substituent_description: A circled benzene carries the sulfonyl S at C1 and AcNH at C3 (meta); S has two =O (drawn as double bonds) and is bonded to N. That N bears a one-carbon vertex leading to Bn, and CH2-C(=O)-NH-N=CH- (hydrazone, C=N double bond). The CH is bonded to C3 of a five-membered N ring (pyrrole drawn with two C=C) that has plain-line methyl stubs on both carbons next to the ring N, and whose N is bonded to a circled benzene with methyl stubs ortho and para to the N attachment (2,4-dimethylphenyl).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Bn is joined to the sulfonamide N through a kinked line, so N-CH2-Bn versus N-Bn is slightly unclear
Four methyl groups are drawn only as unlabelled line stubs
abab5cb525.notes: Handwritten thin dark-grey ink on white paper. Double bonds: two S=O, one C=O, one C=N, two in the five-membered ring. Two benzene rings are circles.

5ee4188f2a.substituent_description: A circled benzene has NH at C1, OCH2CH3 (O, CH2, CH3 written out) at C2 (ortho to the NH) and a 4-methyl-4H-1,2,4-triazol-3-yl at C3 (the triazole ring has three N, an N-CH3, and two drawn double bonds). The NH is bonded to a ring N (N-N bond) of a bicyclic: a circled six-membered ring with one ring N is fused to a second six-membered ring (CH2, CH2, N, CH=C with one C=C drawn). On the circled ring, the carbon between the fusion carbon and the ring N carries a 2,2-dimethyl-3-methoxy azetidin-1-yl (N-azetidine, two CH3 on the carbon next to N, CH3O on the next carbon), and the carbon on the other side of the ring N carries CH3.
5ee4188f2a.notes: Handwritten black ink on white paper. NH is written with H beneath N. Aromatic: circles in the benzene and in the six-membered ring with N; the triazole is drawn with alternating double bonds. Double bonds: two in the triazole, one in the fused second ring. The ring N of the bicyclic is directly bonded to the NH (N-N bond as drawn).

64cc25c179.substituent_description: A piperidine has EtO on a solid wedge at C4, a hashed bond from C2 (next to the ring N) to C1 of a circled benzene, and the ring N bonded to CH2 that is attached to an indole benzo ring. The benzene has O-CH2-CH2-NHAc at C2 (ortho to the piperidine attachment) and HO2C at C4 (para to the piperidine attachment). On the indole (circled benzo ring fused to a five-membered ring with NH and one drawn C=C), the CH2 link is at C4 (next to the fusion carbon C3a), MeO is at C5, and C7 (next to the NH-bearing fusion carbon) carries an unlabelled plain-line methyl stub.
64cc25c179.notes: Handwritten black ink on white paper. The ring N label has small stray tick marks. Two benzene rings are drawn as circles (the substituted phenyl and the indole benzo ring); the five-membered ring of the indole has one inner double line.
